gate.signInBody: Only accounts on the server's <mono>ADMIN_EMAILS</mono> list can sign in.
gate.deniedTitle: This account is not an administrator
gate.deniedBody: Admin access is limited to the email addresses on the server's <mono>ADMIN_EMAILS</mono> list. If you need access, ask a platform admin to add your email there. To manage a shop, use the back office.

pending: This screen is designed but its data is not connected yet.

ui.failedTitle: That request did not go through
ui.failedBody: Nothing is shown here — figures that may be out of date would read as current.

money.excludesRefunds: Revenue and fees exclude refunded and cancelled orders — a refund is not revenue. The order count is every order placed.

stores.loadFailed: Could not load the store list.
stores.emptyBody: The first store to register appears here.
stores.emptyQueryBody: Try the address, or part of the owner's email.

suspend.title: Suspend {{store}}
suspend.pointShoppers: Shoppers see an “unavailable” page instead of the store
suspend.pointOrders: Orders already placed stay in the shoppers’ accounts
suspend.pointOwner: Nothing is sent to the owner: the reason is kept on the store’s record, so get in touch yourself
suspend.notePlaceholder: What happened, and what reinstating needs
suspend.noteTooShort: “Another reason” needs a note of at least {{n}} characters.
suspend.sure: I understand the suspension takes effect at once

detail.notFoundBody: Nothing on the platform answers to “{{sub}}”.
detail.membersSub: Accounts that can manage this store
detail.noMembers: Nobody can run this store yet. Give someone OWNER below.
detail.addMemberHint: The account must have signed in at least once — identities come from Google, so an address nobody has used yet cannot be given a role.
detail.removeMemberConfirm: Remove {{email}} from this store? They lose access to the back office; their shopping history is untouched.

billing.title: Billing
billing.notInvoiced: Invoicing stores and collecting the commission aren't set up yet. These totals are only recorded.
billing.emptyBody: Commission shows up here as soon as a store takes a paid order.

verify.title: Verified store
verify.offBody: Turn it on and shoppers see a verified tick next to the store's name.
verify.onBody: Verified {{at}}. Shoppers see a verified tick next to the store's name.

admins.title: Admins
admins.loadFailed: Could not load the admin list.
admins.emptyBody: Nobody can open this host until an address is added — check ADMIN_EMAILS on the server.
admins.removeSelf: This is your own account — you will lose access to this host.
admins.footOne: This admin comes from the server’s <mono>ADMIN_EMAILS</mono> list.
admins.footTwo: Both admins come from the server’s <mono>ADMIN_EMAILS</mono> list.
admins.footAll: Every admin comes from the server’s <mono>ADMIN_EMAILS</mono> list.
admins.footDb_one: {{n}} admin was added from this screen earlier and can be removed here; the rest come from the server’s <mono>ADMIN_EMAILS</mono> list.
admins.footDb_other: {{n}} admins were added from this screen earlier and can be removed here; the rest come from the server’s <mono>ADMIN_EMAILS</mono> list.
admins.howBody: Admins are not added here. The list comes only from the server’s <mono>ADMIN_EMAILS</mono> variable, so nobody can make themselves an admin from a browser.
admins.howStep1: In Render, open the service’s Environment.
admins.howStep2: Add the email to <mono>ADMIN_EMAILS</mono>, separated by commas.
admins.howStep3: The service restarts, and the admin gets access at their next sign-in.

config.title: Configuration
config.storeOfflineHint: Nothing can be written right now, and values changed here are not in effect: the environment's value applies everywhere, and the bank environment is {{bank}}. Check the <mono>esy-config</mono> service on Render.
config.feeHint: {{from}} → {{to}} · 0–{{max}}%. Applies to new orders; the commission on orders already placed doesn't change. You'll confirm the change once more before it's saved.
config.feeInvalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to {{max}}, e.g. 2.5.
config.urlHint: Starts with https://. Blank takes it from the environment.
config.urlInvalid: The address must start with http:// or https://.
config.bankDescLive: Real payments. Changing it redirects every store's card payments.
config.bankDescSandbox: The test environment: card payments go to the test bank and no real money is charged.
config.bankDescOffline: Until the store is back, the environment's value applies: card payments go to the test bank.
config.advancedSub: The bank's sign-in and API addresses. Blank takes them from the environment.
config.reservedSub: Names no store can take. They protect the platform's own addresses, manager and admin included. Read-only.
config.reservedEmpty: The server returned no reserved names.
config.volatile: The store is on the free plan and can be emptied when it restarts. A value changed here then falls back to the environment's, so anything that must survive belongs in the Render environment too.
config.feePointNew: Applies to every store's new orders, within seconds
config.feePointOld: The commission on orders already placed doesn't change
config.feePointEnv: The store can be emptied: write <mono>{{line}}</mono> in the Render environment too
config.bankPointSandbox: Card payments in every store move to the test bank: shoppers can no longer actually pay
config.bankPointLive: Card payments in every store move to the real bank, with real money: each store's saved keys must be live keys
config.bankPointNow: The change takes effect within seconds, in every store at once

desc.serviceFeeRate: The platform's share of every order, as a fraction.
desc.bogAuthUrl: Bank of Georgia auth endpoint. Blank derives it from the environment.
desc.bogBaseUrl: Bank of Georgia API base. Blank derives it from the environment.
desc.designEnabled: Store design system: looks at sign-up, and each store's published theme and layout. Off keeps every store on today's look.

integrations.title: SMS and email
integrations.loadFailed: Could not load SMS and email settings.
integrations.storeOffline: The config store is unreachable, so nothing on this screen can be saved. Current values are shown but every edit will fail until it is back.
integrations.smsSub: SMS Office · the code and orders
integrations.senderEnvNote: When you change it here, write <mono>APP_SMS_SENDER</mono> in the Render environment too: the store can restart and lose a sender changed here.
integrations.smsNoKey: There's no SMS Office key, so no SMS is sent — not even the verification code, so new accounts can't finish registering. Add <mono>APP_SMS_KEY</mono> to the environment.
integrations.smsOff: SMS is off. Not even the verification code is sent, so new accounts can't finish registering until you turn it back on.
integrations.lastFailureTitle: SMS Office refused the last message
integrations.senderAdvice: Ask SMS Office to approve the sender or change it; until then registration codes don't go out either.
integrations.emailNoKey: There's no Resend key, so no email is sent. Orders still work, just without a letter. Add <mono>APP_EMAIL_KEY</mono> to the environment.
integrations.emailDisabledWarning: Email is switched off. Orders still work — shoppers simply hear nothing by mail.
integrations.keysNote: API keys are secret and kept in the Render environment. They're never shown or changed here.
integrations.codeRejected: Not delivered — the sender isn't approved
integrations.codeNoKey: Not sent — there's no SMS key
integrations.cancelNote: No SMS goes out on a cancellation or a refund: that's a conversation, often about money, and one line isn't enough to start it.
integrations.orderCounted: <mono>{order}</mono> is counted at the longest number, <mono>#99999</mono>.
integrations.unicode: Georgian text is Unicode: 70 characters is one SMS, 71 is already two.
integrations.notCounted: <mono>{store}</mono> and <mono>{url}</mono> aren't counted here; they lengthen the message when it's sent.
integrations.emailPlain: Plain text — the HTML is generated, so markup here is escaped rather than rendered.
integrations.offPointCode: The verification code stops going out: new accounts can't finish registering until you turn SMS back on
integrations.offPointOrders: Order texts stop; email still goes out
integrations.senderNotApproved: The sender {{sender}} is not approved yet · {{when}}.
